name: gpt-realtime-voice-test-harness
description: Localhost GPT-Realtime voice testing harness for speech-in/speech-out validation with Swedish conversation support

scripts.test: echo 'Manual browser testing - see quickstart.md for validation scenarios'
scripts.setup: cp .env.example .env && echo 'Environment file created. Please edit .env with your OpenAI API key.'
scripts.validate: node -e "require('dotenv').config(); if(!process.env.OPENAI_API_KEY || process.env.OPENAI_API_KEY.includes('your-openai-api-key-here')) { console.error('❌ Please set OPENAI_API_KEY in .env file'); process.exit(1); } else { console.log('✅ Environment configuration looks good'); }"
